chapter_title: Concerning the living Fire: It is present in Eight
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Eight States of Divine Love

**¶1:** The [GAP-1] living divine love is present in eight distinct states of spiritual order.

**¶2:** The first state in which it dwells is the [GAP-2] ground of wisdom [GAP-3] in which it abides and has its being. It is established as the most interior principle [GAP-4], utterly beyond the whole of created order. It is the foundation and supporting ground of the entire regenerate will, and the deepest interior perception that underlies all other states.

**¶3:** The second state in which it dwells is the Divine Itself, the Divine Good of Divine Truth; because the Divine Itself is established in its infinite and omnipotent interior perception. Thus, first within the Divine Itself. All the derivative divine faculties that proceeded from the Divine were made manifest through it, and divine love too came forth with them and was revealed through their proceeding.

**¶4:** The third [GAP-5] state in which it dwells is the Celestial Human — the most ancient spiritual form — who [GAP-6] was clothed in protecting truths. Again, it is this divine love [GAP-7] resting upon the external form of the fully regenerate will.

**¶5:** The fourth is this divine love that was separated and purified from all the [GAP-8] faculties of wisdom, which dwells in the outermost boundary of spiritual order, in the containing form of illuminated understanding.

**¶6:** The fifth is this divine love that abides in the containing form of faith in states of spiritual obscurity, [GAP-9] dwelling within truth itself.

**¶7:** [GAP-10] The sixth is this divine love that is purified and distinguished from all derivative forms. The Divine Truth Proceeding [GAP-11] clothed its own external form with this love, over and above both the calling forth and the reception. It ordered and established all things through this love. It descended into lower natural states and divested itself of this love before the Guardian of the threshold between spiritual and natural degrees.

**¶8:** The seventh is this living divine love belonging to the regenerated natural mind, and it is interior perception itself. For it is the primary founding principle in the regenerated will, upon which all things were built anew [GAP-12] as the first ordering truth, which is the governing crown over the whole natural mind. These principles lie beneath the whole of spiritual order, yet reign over the entire natural mind that had been dominated by falsity from evil [GAP-13] within it, throughout the [GAP-14] whole [GAP-15] of its extent.

**¶9:** [GAP-16] The eighth is the divine love that shall be made manifest in the final [GAP-17] state of the human spirit, and it signifies spiritual temptation and combat. Furthermore it [GAP-18] displays and makes evident its presence through the upheaval of judgment. It shall be revealed through both containing forms of celestial and spiritual illumination.

**¶10:** This is the manner in which holy living divine love exists throughout these [GAP-19] eight states of spiritual order.

---

*Note on method:* "Consideration" (Coptic rendering of a Persian/Aramaic contemplative term) consistently translates as **interior perception** — the deepest reflective faculty by which spiritual realities are apprehended. The "ships" of day and night correspond to **containing forms** (vessels) of understanding in illumination and faith in obscurity, respectively. The "Porter" corresponds to the **guardian principle** at the threshold between discrete degrees — the boundary between the spiritual and natural minds where what is higher must divest itself to pass into what is lower. This descent-and-divestiture pattern closely mirrors what Swedenborg describes as the accommodation of influx between degrees.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The [holy] living f[ire] is present i[n] eight places.

The first place wherein it is, is this [light] land [where it is present and] exists. It is established beneath [it, and is ut]terly beyond the totality. It is the foundation and basis of that great earth, and the consideratio[n th]at is beneath them all.

The second place wherein it is, is the Father, the God of truth; because [the Fathe]r is established in his great, mighty consideration. So, [firs]t in the Father. The other powers that came from him were revealed through him, and (the fire) too came w[i]th them [and was revea]led by them.
The third [place wherein it is], is the First Man, h[e] wh[o was clothed in the five sons as his] armour. Again, it is this fire [ ... ... ] on the body of the Perfect Man.
[The fourth is this fir]e that was purified from all the [light] powers, [which is i]n the outer wall, in the ship of the day.
[The fifth i]s this fire that is in the light-giver of the night [and dwells] within the water.

[The] sixth is this f[i]re that is purified from the totality. The Living [Spirit] swathed it upon his body, over the summons and the obedience. He has established many things by it. He went down and stripped himself of it before the Por[t]er.

The seventh is this living fire that is of the new earth, and is the consideration. For it is the first foundation in the new earth, it they built anew [ ... ... ] the first course, that is a crown for the entire earth. T[hey] are below the totality, over the entire earth of da[rkne]ss [that is] in it, in the [ ... ] whole [earth]

[The] eigh[th] is the fire that shall be revealed in this [last time upon every] person, and it signifies fear and war. Furthermore it [ ... ] it displays and manifests its sign in [its ter]ror. It shall be r[ev]ealed in these two light ships.
This i[s the way] that the holy living fire exists in these [eight places].

fills.explanation: The epithet "holy" is the standard qualifier for the living fire throughout the Kephalaia, confirmed by ¶10's closing formula "the holy living fire," and the spiritual reading simply affirms this as a marker of divine origin.
The "Light Land" is the standard Manichaean term for the primordial realm of the Father of Greatness, corresponding to the ground of wisdom (light = wisdom) in the spiritual reading.

The spiritual reading's "in which it abides and has its being" confirms this formulaic phrase linking presence to existence, matching the Kephalaia's repetitive expository style for describing indwelling.

The fire of the Light Land is established beneath everything ("beneath it") and transcends creation ("and is utterly beyond the totality"), matching the spiritual reading's "most interior principle, utterly beyond the whole of created order."

This is the formulaic phrase repeated for each of the eight places ("The Nth place wherein it is, is..."), as seen in ¶2 and ¶3, confirmed by the spiritual reading's parallel "state in which it dwells."

fills.explanation: The First Man clothing himself in the five sons as his armour is the most stereotyped formula in Manichaean cosmology; the spiritual reading's "was clothed in protecting truths" confirms the passive clothing imagery, with "protecting truths" corresponding to the five sons/elements.
"Light powers" is the standard Kephalaia term for the divine emanations; the spiritual reading's "faculties of wisdom" confirms light = wisdom in correspondential logic.

The spiritual reading's "dwelling within truth itself" requires a verb of indwelling; "and dwells" extends the syntax ("is in the light-giver of the night and dwells within the water") to express the fire's double location in the moon and in the celestial waters.
The definite article opens each numbered paragraph in the series, following the established pattern of "The Nth is this fire..."

The "Living Spirit" is the standard Manichaean divine figure (Mihryazd) who acts as cosmic demiurge; the spiritual reading identifies this as "Divine Truth Proceeding," which corresponds exactly to the Living Spirit's cosmological role.
A standard Coptic relative clause construction connecting "the entire earth of darkness" to "in it," specifying that the darkness is located within the new earth over which the foundation was laid.

The chapter's pervasive vocabulary of "earth" (great earth, new earth, earth of darkness, entire earth) makes "whole earth" the natural completion, corresponding to the spiritual reading's "whole of its extent" where "earth" is the natural-plane term for the domain of the natural mind.
The definite article opens the eighth and final entry in the series, following the same formulaic pattern as all preceding paragraphs.

The eschatological context (fire + fear + war + revelation in the two light ships) strongly constrains this to the Manichaean end-time judgment; "last time" renders the spiritual reading's "final state," and "upon every person" explains how the fire universally signifies fear and war.

The closing formula mirrors the opening statement of ¶1 ("present in eight places"), creating the standard Kephalaia inclusio structure confirmed by the spiritual reading's "eight states of spiritual order."
